stories.title: Enver Altaylı, Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında ifade verecek

en.title: Enver Altaylı to give statement in Kozinoğlu investigation
en.summary: A convicted FETÖ member named Enver Altaylı has been called to testify in an investigation related to Kaşif Kozinoğlu's death.

stories.title: Büyükçekmece'de toprak kayması: 1 işçi göçük altında

en.title: Soil collapse in Büyükçekmece: 1 worker buried
en.summary: A soil collapse occurred at a residential construction site in Istanbul's Büyükçekmece district, trapping a worker beneath the debris.

stories.title: Enver Altaylı da Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında ifadeye çağrıldı: Kızı tepki gösterdi

en.title: Enver Altaylı summoned in Kozinoğlu investigation: Daughter protests
en.summary: A convicted FETÖ member called to testify in the Kozinoğlu investigation had his transfer halted on medical grounds, prompting his daughter to object given his age and health concerns.

stories.title: Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında Hasan Atilla Uğur’un avukatından açıklama: 'Kamera kayıtlarını müvekkilim talep etti'

en.title: Hasan Atilla Uğur's lawyer issues statement in Kozinoğlu investigation: 'My client requested camera footage'
en.summary: The lawyer for Hasan Atilla Uğur stated that his client requested the camera recordings and that the footage shows Uğur assisting Kozinoğlu when he became ill, while noting misinformation has spread on social media.

en.title: 4 new detentions in Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation
en.summary: Four additional people were detained in connection with an ongoing investigation into Kaşif Kozinoğlu's death.

stories.title: Büyükçekmece’de inşaatta toprak kayması: 1 işçi hayatını kaybetti

en.title: Soil collapse at construction site in Büyükçekmece: 1 worker killed
en.summary: A construction site collapse in Büyükçekmece resulted in one worker's death and another's rescue, with three people detained in relation to the incident.

stories.title: Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturması: 4 kişi daha gözaltına alındı

en.title: Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation: 4 more people detained
en.summary: Four additional people were detained during simultaneous operations in Istanbul and Tekirdağ as part of the investigation into Kaşif Kozinoğlu's death.

stories.title: Son dakika: Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturmasında 4 gözaltı daha! Cezaevi müdürü de listede

en.title: Breaking: 4 more detentions in Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation! Prison director also on list
en.summary: A significant development occurred in the investigation into the death of former MIT official Kaşif Kozinoğlu in prison, with four detentions made during operations in Istanbul and Tekirdağ.

stories.title: 20 Eylül Pazar günü hangi yollar trafiğe kapalı olacak? Fatih ve Beyoğlu'nda trafiğe kapatılacak yollar ve caddeler...

en.title: Which roads will be closed to traffic on Sunday, September 20? Roads and streets to be closed to traffic in Fatih and Beyoğlu...
en.summary: Several main streets and roads in Istanbul's Fatih and Beyoğlu districts will be temporarily closed to vehicle traffic on September 20 due to a sporting event.

stories.title: Büyükçekmece'de toprak kayması: Göçük altında kalan 1 işçiden acı haber

en.title: Landslide in Büyükçekmece: Tragic news from 1 worker trapped under rubble
en.summary: A landslide at a construction site in Istanbul's Büyükçekmece district left two workers trapped, with one rescued and one fatally killed.

stories.title: Fon soruşturmasında Tera Yatırım'ın patronu da gözaltına alındı

en.title: Fund investigation: Tera Yatırım's boss also detained
en.summary: The owner of Tera Yatırım has been detained as part of an investigation conducted by Istanbul's Chief Public Prosecutor's Office.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA... Fon soruşturmasında yeni gelişme! Pusula Portföy yöneticilerinden Serdar Turhan ile Tera yöneticisi Emre Tezmen gözaltında

en.title: BREAKING... New development in fund investigation! Pusula portfolio manager Serdar Turhan and Tera manager Emre Tezmen detained
en.summary: Serdar Turhan, chairman of Pusula Holding, and Emre Tezmen, chairman of Tera Yatırım Holding, have been detained in a capital markets investigation by Istanbul's Chief Public Prosecutor's Office.

stories.title: Bakan Fidan'dan Suudi Arabistan'a destek: Sözümüzün eriyiz

en.title: Foreign Minister Fidan shows support for Saudi Arabia: We stand by our word
en.summary: Turkey's Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan expressed support for Saudi Arabia, citing serious attacks on its territorial integrity and sovereignty. He stated Turkey honors its alliance agreement and condemned attacks on oil infrastructure near Mecca.

stories.title: Yapay zeka devlerine dava: Gelişimi yavaşlatmak için anlaştıkları öne sürüldü

en.title: Lawsuit against AI giants: Alleged collusion to slow development
en.summary: Four AI service subscribers filed a lawsuit in the US against Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Google, alleging they coordinated to slow AI technology development in violation of competition laws. Plaintiffs argue the coordination reduces consumer value from paid AI services.

stories.title: Trump, yapay zeka için yönetici atayacak

en.title: Trump to appoint executive for artificial intelligence
en.summary: US President Donald Trump announced the creation of an artificial intelligence team and the appointment of an AI Czar to maintain the country's leading position in the AI race.

en.title: Salah's night: 4 goals from Trabzonspor against Galatasaray
en.summary: In the sixth week of the Turkish Super League, Trabzonspor defeated Galatasaray 4-0 at home. Mohamed Salah delivered a standout performance with three goals and one assist, leading his team to the decisive victory.

stories.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan, BM Genel Kurulu için ABD'ye gidecek

en.title: President Erdoğan to Travel to the United States for UN General Assembly
en.summary: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan will visit the United States from September 20-23 to attend the 81st UN General Assembly general debate, where he is scheduled to address the assembly on September 22.
